description: 综合填空题库（人工审核版）。每题 prompt/clue/answer 一一对应。

questions.prompt: I ___ the Gingerbread House.
questions.analysis: 描述过去参观，用 visit 的过去式 visited。

questions.prompt: I ___ to Xi'an with my family.
questions.clue: 中文：我和家人去了西安。

questions.prompt: Please ___ me some pictures.
questions.clue: 中文：请发给我一些照片。
questions.analysis: 祈使句用动词原形 send。

questions.prompt: We ___ to see the Terracotta Warriors.
questions.clue: 中文：我们去看了兵马俑。

questions.prompt: It was great / fun / ___!
questions.analysis: 形容词 amazing 表示“极好的”。

questions.prompt: There are over seven thousand ___ warriors.
Did you ___ mooncakes?
